items.Title: Primer Oficial
items.ExternalDescriptionStr:
Copa Airlines is committed to air safety and the satisfaction of our passengers. Join us and be part of a strong, dynamic, and resilient company that connects travelers through the Hub of the Americas, operating the youngest and most modern fleet in the region. 

We are continuously growing and seeking B737 First Officers who share our commitment to safety and customer service.  Our First Officers safely assist the Captain in operating the aircraft in accordance with all local and international Aviation Regulations and company policies and procedures.

Requirements

  • Minimum age: Twenty-one (21) years.
  • Commercial Pilot license
  • Current unrestricted First-class medical certificate
  • For Panamanians, minimum of 250 hours of total time in fixed wing aircraft
  • For foreign applicants: A minimum of 1,000 hours of total flight time in fixed-wing aircraft
  • Multiengine and instrument Rating
  • Minimum ICAO English Language Proficiency level 5
  • A valid tourism visa for the United States

Benefits

  • We offer a competitive compensation package, health insurance, and travel benefits for employees and their families.

Before submitting your application, please read the following carefully:

We will only consider applications from candidates who provide all the required documentation.

Once you submit your application, you will not be able to modify it or upload additional documents.

To ensure a successful application, please submit the following documentation:

  • Resume
  • Copy of your ID or passport
  • Copy of your Commercial or ATP Pilot License
  • Copy of your current unrestricted First-Class Medical Certificate 
  • Copy of your updated Logbook sealed by a valid Aviation Authority
